scope: L7 unified workspace (frontend), L9 fourteen recreations, backend contract files read-only
quality_notes: Both judges returned zero findings in one read-only sweep each.

Judge A emitted prose before the JSON (protocol asked for JSON only) and its evidence contains checkable inaccuracies: it cites 3 form-model tests (there are 4) and a workspace pagination test that does not exist.
Judge B asserted that all frozen hashes were verified without any recorded hash computation.

An empty result from two blind judges is not proof of absence of defects; the browser session found four real defects before this review (digest path, narrow-screen order, plurals, mean decimals), which unit tests and typing had missed.
Approval here is a review state only. It is not a functional check, a native review receipt or delivery authority.
